visualCharacteristics.purpose: Frequently asked questions list that expands and collapses each answer
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked full-width items separated by rules; question row with chevron toggles the answer below (native details/summary)

contentPattern.structure: One row per item with two cells: question text | answer rich text (paragraphs, links, lists)

reuseGuidance: Use for any FAQ or expandable Q&A list. Prefer over the generic accordion when items are simple question/answer pairs.
